d: COGNNA is a fast-growing cybersecurity startup revolutionizing how businesses manage their security operations. Our innovative SaaS platform empowers SMEs and enterprises to detect, prevent, and respond to cyber threats with agility and confidence. Headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, we’re building a resilient, AI-powered future for cybersecurity — locally and globally.

We are seeking a hands-on Sales Manager who will lead, coach, and develop a sales team while maintaining direct responsibility for an assigned portfolio of customer accounts and an individual revenue target. The successful candidate will be accountable for both personal sales achievement and the team's overall performance.
q: li
7–10+ years of B2B technology sales experience, including at least 4–5 years in cybersecurity.
li
Minimum 2–3 years of proven sales team leadership or management experience.
li
Demonstrated track record of achieving both individual and team sales targets.
li
Strong experience selling cybersecurity solutions, managed security services, and SaaS subscriptions.
li
Solid understanding of SOC, MDR, MSSP, SIEM, EDR, XDR, and related cybersecurity technologies.
li
Good understanding of Saudi cybersecurity regulations, particularly NCA and SAMA requirements.
li
Proven experience selling to enterprise and mid-market customers in Saudi Arabia.
li
Established relationships with CISOs, CIOs, IT Directors, and other senior decision-makers.
li
Strong sales forecasting, pipeline management, and CRM skills, preferably HubSpot.
li
Excellent leadership, coaching, negotiation, and communication skills.
li
Fluent Arabic and strong English proficiency.
li
Bachelor's degree in Business, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
r: Lead, coach, and manage the assigned sales team to achieve individual and collective revenue targets.
Personally manage a portfolio of customer accounts and achieve an assigned individual ARR target.
Drive new business acquisition, account expansion, and revenue growth.
Manage sales pipeline, opportunity qualification, forecasting, and CRM discipline.
Lead customer engagements, commercial negotiations, and complex deal closures.
Conduct regular sales reviews, individual coaching sessions, and performance evaluations.
Work closely with Pre-Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Customer Success to accelerate opportunities and ensure customer satisfaction.
Maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers across the Saudi market.
x: 🚀 Impact that Matters – Build products that shape the future of cybersecurity and protect organizations globally.
🏢 On-Site Collaboration – Be at the heart of innovation in our Almadina office, working side by side with passionate experts.
💡 Continuous Growth – Access to certifications, trainings, and opportunities to sharpen your expertise.
📈 Ownership Mindset – Benefit from our ESOP program and grow with COGNNA’s success.
🤝 Culture of Trust – We empower talent, encourage ownership, and celebrate real outcomes.

d: Own the translation of commercial plans into visible, measurable in-store execution across SharkNinja's retail footprint, ensuring the brand shows up correctly at every touchpoint, that our field team sells effectively, and that returned stock is controlled, inspected, and resolved without leaking value.
q: li
2–3 years in retail/trade execution, field sales or merchandising, consumer electronics, SDA or FMCG preferred.
li
Experience working with or supervising promoters, merchandisers or brand experts.
li
Strong Excel and reporting discipline; comfortable working with sell-out data.
li
Hands-on, organized and comfortable spending most of the week in the field.
li
Valid driving license. Arabic and English are essential
li
Willingness to travel across GCC markets.
r: Execute agreed planograms, displays, demo zones and promotional activity across assigned accounts; ensure launches land on time and in full.
Monitor and drive on-shelf availability (OSA), share of shelf, pricing accuracy and POSM compliance; escalate gaps to the commercial team with corrective actions.
Conduct structured store visits with documented call reports and photo evidence; maintain an execution scorecard by account and by market.
Coordinate with retailer store management on stock replenishment, display maintenance and activation logistics.
Onboard, schedule and manage the promoter / brand expert network across assigned doors, including third-party agency coordination.
Deliver product training so every brand expert can demonstrate and sell the full range with confidence; refresh training at each new launch.
Set and track individual sell-out targets, conversion and demo counts; review performance regularly and address underperformance.
Control promoter cost, attendance, grooming standards and daily reporting discipline.
Receive and inspect all customer and retailer returns; classify by condition and root cause (defective, damaged, buyer's remorse, DOA).
Maintain accurate return records and disposition: resale, refurbishment, warranty claim or write-off, in line with policy.
Act as the operational link between Trade, Customer Care and Warehouse to close return cases within agreed SLAs.
Analyze return trends by SKU and by account, and feed insight back to the commercial and quality teams to reduce recurrence.
Provide weekly sell-out, execution compliance, promoter productivity and returns reporting to the Senior Regional Expansion Manager.
